name: limit-bars
description: Shows the 5-hour and 7-day rate limits live as two bars above the prompt, with each window's reset time on the right; after an account switch at once the new account's.

display.title: Display
display.description: auto = big bars above the prompt where they can be drawn (terminal, desktop Code tab), the little status line everywhere else; big = only the big bars; little = only the little status line; both = both.

reading.title: Server reading
reading.description: While no response brings new figures (the session is idle), every how many minutes the bars ask the server for the account's usage: a short second claude, no model request, no tokens. off = only right after an account switch.
